mapper.update: UPDATE Alltotle a JOIN ( SELECT p.user_id, p.teacher_name, SUM( CASE WHEN d.dict_label IN ( 'SCI分区Ⅰ区', 'SCI分区Ⅱ区', 'SCI分区Ⅲ区', 'SCI分区Ⅳ区' ) THEN p.research_score ELSE 0 END ) AS `SCI`, SUM( CASE WHEN d.dict_label = 'EI期刊论文' THEN p.research_score ELSE 0 END ) AS `EI`, SUM( CASE WHEN d.dict_label = '核心期刊文章（北大、 南大核心；社科类）' THEN p.research_score ELSE 0 END ) AS `hx`, SUM( CASE WHEN d.dict_label = '三网收录论文' THEN p.research_score ELSE 0 END ) AS `sw`, SUM( CASE WHEN d.dict_label = '普通期刊' THEN p.research_score ELSE 0 END ) AS `pt`, SUM( CASE WHEN d.dict_label = '校办期刊' THEN p.research_score ELSE 0 END ) AS `xb`, sum( p.research_score ) AS `总分数` FROM sci_paper_a p LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data d ON d.dict_type = 'sci_paper_k' AND p.paper_category = d.dict_value WHERE p.state = 8 GROUP BY p.user_id, p.teacher_name ORDER BY p.user_id ) sp ON a.userId = sp.user_id SET a.SCI = sp.SCI, a.EI = sp.EI, a.hx = sp.hx, a.sw = sp.sw, a.pt = sp.pt, a.xb = sp.xb
